check_help: Tests use saved settings and make a sample request to Google. Quota or charges may apply.
check_result_missing: Enter and save the required credentials and settings first.
check_result_busy: This test is already running. Try again shortly.
check_result_billing: Google reported a billing problem. Check billing in Google Cloud Console.
check_result_disabled: Google reported that the API is disabled. Enable it in Google Cloud Console.
check_result_credentials: Google credentials are invalid or could not be loaded. Check and save them again.
check_result_quota: Google reported a quota or rate limit. Check usage and quotas in Google Cloud Console.
check_result_access: Google denied access. Check API enablement, billing, and key restrictions or service account permissions.
check_result_unreachable: Google did not respond in time or is unavailable. Try again later.
check_result_failed: The test failed. Check the saved settings and try again.
groups_intro: Create named groups of announcement speakers to use in Flows or as a device default.
group_ip_help: Reserve fixed IP addresses for your Sonos speakers in your router. With Play Separately, Homey can reuse known addresses instead of scanning the network, so announcements can start faster.
group_members_help: Select the speakers in this group. Offline members are skipped during announcements.
group_volume_help: The adjustment and maximum apply only when the Flow sets a speaker volume.
group_no_speakers: No speakers found. Turn on your speakers and refresh the list.
groups_starting: The app is still starting. Try opening the Groups tab again in a moment.
group_delete_confirm: Delete "__name__"? Flows and device defaults that use it will need a new selection.
sonos_save_error: Could not save the Sonos mode.
sonos_load_error: Could not load the Sonos mode.
